headline: MD simulations map membrane-dependent conformational states in diverse protein systems
label: Conformational Ensemble Modeling
summary: Recent published MD studies resolve membrane-coupled conformations and assembly across kinase, defensin, viral, and septin proteins.
synthesis: The dominant thread is simulation-based characterization of how membrane environments shape protein conformation and assembly. Full-length dimeric DspS dynamics are mapped by combining AlphaFold-Multimer, accelerated MD, and Markov state modeling, while hBD-3 monomers and dimers are sampled over 57.0 μs of all-atom MD in model membranes, with contact-matrix PCA/LDA applied to the resulting structural states. Septin Cdc12 amphipathic helix pairs adopt a bent, membrane-bound conformation with antiparallel salt-bridged cooperative binding. The SARS-CoV-2 M protein study extends the thread toward assembly, reporting that self-interactions alone drive membrane clustering in MD and continuum models, with direct oligomerization dominating. Together these studies couple conformational sampling to lipid context across distinct protein classes.
